lanes.label: The last days and last words
Elsewhere in scripture
lanes.range: Topics in other books wired to this one

nodes.t: Stir up the gift; do not be ashamed of the gospel
nodes.d: Paul remembers Timothy's sincere faith and tells him to stir up God's gift, not be ashamed of the testimony, and share in the afflictions of the gospel, since God saved and called us by his own purpose and grace and Christ brought life and immortality to light.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain what Paul tells Timothy to do in 1:6-8 and why (1:9-10)?
ev: Say whose faith dwelt in Timothy first (1:5)

nodes.d: Paul's last letter in this collection, written as a prisoner to Timothy, urging faithfulness, endurance, trust in Scripture and preaching the word until the end.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain in a few sentences what 2 Timothy is about?
ev: Describe the four chapters: not ashamed (1), endure and handle the word (2), Scripture in the last days (3), the charge and Paul's last words (4)

nodes.t: Those who turned away and Onesiphorus who refreshed Paul
nodes.d: Paul notes that all in Asia have turned away from him, including Phygellus and Hermogenes, while Onesiphorus often refreshed him and sought him out in Rome.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} tell what Onesiphorus did for Paul and why Paul prays for him (1:16-18)?
ev: Tell what Onesiphorus did in Rome (1:17)

nodes.t: Strong in grace: soldier, athlete, farmer
nodes.d: Timothy is to pass on what he heard to faithful men, endure hardness as a good soldier, strive lawfully like an athlete and labour like a farmer; Paul endures for the elect, and the faithful saying says if we die with him we shall live with him.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain the soldier, athlete and farmer pictures in 2:3-6 and what they teach?

nodes.d: Timothy is to avoid wrangling about words and profane babblings, rightly handle the word of truth, and flee youthful lusts; the Lord's servant must be gentle and patient, instructing opponents in hope that God grants repentance.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain what it means to be a workman who rightly divides the word of truth (2:15)?
ev: Describe how the Lord's servant treats opponents (2:24-26)

nodes.t: Perilous times in the last days
nodes.d: Paul describes men in the last days with a form of godliness but denying its power, compares them to Jannes and Jambres who withstood Moses, and says they will not progress further.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} describe what Paul says about people in the last days and what Timothy should do about them (3:1-5)?
ev: List several marks of the men in 3:2-4
Say who Jannes and Jambres are compared to (3:8)

nodes.t: Continue in Scripture, inspired by God
nodes.d: Timothy is to continue in what he learned, having known the holy scriptures from childhood; all scripture is given by inspiration of God and is profitable for teaching, reproof, correction and training in righteousness, so the man of God is thoroughly furnished.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain what 3:16-17 says about Scripture and what it is for?
ev: Say what the scriptures are able to do (3:15)

nodes.t: Preach the word: Paul's charge and finished course
nodes.d: Paul charges Timothy before God and Christ to preach the word in season and out, warns of those who will not endure sound doctrine, and says he is ready to be offered, having fought the good fight and awaiting a crown of righteousness.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain what Paul charges Timothy to do and what Paul says awaits him (4:2, 4:7-8)?
ev: Describe what Paul says of his own course in 4:6-8

nodes.d: Paul asks Timothy to come, names companions who left or remain, recounts that none stood with him at his first answer but the Lord stood with him, and sends greetings.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} say who stood with Paul at his first defence and what he asks Timothy to bring (4:11-17)?
ev: Say who is with Paul in 4:11
Tell who stood with Paul at his first answer (4:16-17)

nodes.d: Paul's letter to Timothy at Ephesus about sound doctrine, prayer, order in the church, qualified leaders, and a minister's conduct and charge.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain in a few sentences what 1 Timothy is about (see 3:14-15)?
ev: Describe how 3:15 states the letter's purpose
Name the main sections: false teaching, prayer and conduct, leaders, Timothy's ministry, groups in the church, closing charge
